facts.label: Razões no passado
facts.sub: Conte o que aconteceu no passado simples e explique com because + frase: It broke because it fell on the floor.

facts.label: Porque
facts.sub: Use because para dar uma razão: I dropped it because I was in a hurry. Depois de because, escreva uma frase completa, com sujeito e verbo. Não diga because of I.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o que aconteceu, use o passado simples: I dropped it. It broke. I lost my case. Verbos regulares terminam em -ed. Break e lose são irregulares.

The past of drop is droped.

pages.title: A phone shop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in a phone shop in Nashville. Small tools lie on the table. Noel works behind the counter. Luisa comes in with a broken phone. The screen has many small cracks. Noel looks at it and asks a question.
“Hi, Luisa! What happened to your phone?” says Noel. “I dropped it yesterday because I was in a hurry.” says Luisa. “Oh no. Did the screen break?” says Noel.
